description: Manage states and their country assignment

help.title: About States
help.overview: States, cantons, or provinces provide the middle level of the address geography. Every record requires a name and code and must belong to a country.

sections.title: Manage states
items: Create or edit the name, code, and country assignment.
Cities may reference a state, but that state selection is optional.
Deleting a state is a soft delete and it can be restored.
